Overview

Umeå is a city in Västerbotten with a population of 128,000. A vibrant university city in northern Sweden, known for its birch trees, music scene, and Arctic research. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
